limitations: Only discrete FK configurations at every reference time are checked; no continuous collision certificate.
First four joints use quintic interpolation, last three use analytic wrist coordination; TCP position is not a straight line.
dq_ref uses centered finite differences of the coordinated q table; holds and quintic segment endpoints use exact zero.
Cube remains at initial qpos; no carried-object envelope or contact grasp is validated.
Gravity bias is evaluated at zero qvel; no dynamic tracking, torque cap or tracking tolerance has been tested.
